title: Declining an Invitation
context: Leo 邀请朋友 Maya 周六共进晚餐。Maya 感谢邀请并明确婉拒，不需要详细解释；Leo 尊重她的决定。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Maya, would you like to join us for dinner on Saturday?
dialogue.zh: Maya，周六你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Thanks for inviting me, Leo, but I cannot make it.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，Leo，不过我去不了。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: I understand. We will miss you.
dialogue.zh: 我明白。我们会想念你的。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: That is kind of you. I need a quiet evening at home.
dialogue.zh: 你真贴心。我需要在家安静地度过一个晚上。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Of course. I hope you have a restful evening.
dialogue.zh: 当然。希望你度过一个放松的晚上。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Thank you. Who else is coming to dinner?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。还有谁会来吃晚饭？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: A few friends from our art class are coming.
dialogue.zh: 我们美术课上的几个朋友会来。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Please say hello to them for me.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: I will. We are trying a new restaurant downtown.
dialogue.zh: 我会的。我们要去市中心尝试一家新餐厅。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: That sounds nice. I hope you all enjoy it.
dialogue.zh: 听起来不错。希望你们玩得开心。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Thanks. I will tell you about it next week.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我下周会告诉你情况。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I would like that. Have a lovely dinner!
dialogue.zh: 我很乐意听。祝你们晚餐愉快！

expressions.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，用于表达感谢。
expressions.example: Thanks for inviting me to dinner.

expressions.zh: 我去不了，清楚而礼貌地拒绝邀请。
expressions.example: I cannot make it on Saturday.

expressions.zh: 一个安静的夜晚，可简短说明自己的需要。
expressions.example: I need a quiet evening at home.

expressions.en: say hello to them for me
expressions.example: Please say hello to your friends for me.

expressions.zh: 祝晚餐愉快，用于友好结束谈话。

pronunciation: inviting 重音在第二音节 /ɪnˈvaɪtɪŋ/；Saturday 重音在第一音节 /ˈsætərdeɪ/。说 cannot make it 时突出 cannot，使拒绝清楚。

practice.title: Part 1 · Invitations
practice.prompt: How do you respond when a friend invites you somewhere?
practice.answer: I thank my friend and check whether I am free. If I cannot go, I say so clearly and kindly.

practice.title: Part 2 · An invitation
practice.prompt: Describe an invitation you could not accept. Say who invited you, what it was for, and how you responded.
practice.answer: A friend once invited me to a weekend concert. I was tired after a busy week and wanted to stay home, so I thanked her and said I could not make it. I did not give a long explanation. She understood and went with other friends. The next week she told me about the music, and I was glad she had enjoyed the evening. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Personal boundaries
practice.prompt: Why can it be useful to decline an invitation clearly?
practice.answer: A clear answer helps the other person plan. It can also protect your time while keeping the conversation respectful.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用三到五句感谢邀请、明确拒绝并友好结束；如有意愿，可以提出其他安排。
